content:
Alex Chen: Quick recap from two onboarding calls today. Capturing feature asks + renewal signals.
Alex Chen: Major pain: finance teams can't reconcile per-route charges to our invoices. They see totals diverging.
Alex Chen: Request: exportable daily per-route billing CSV to hand to accounting.
Priya Singh: Can we already export per-route metrics from analytics? @Sophia Park
Sophia Park: We store per-route counters but billing export doesn't include them. Need eng + billing to add fields.
Tom Reed: Minimal export fields: `route_id,date,tokens,cost_usd,invoice_reference`. That will unblock finance reconciliations.
Lena Morales: CS ask: add "verify billing mapping with finance" as an onboarding checklist item so AMs catch this early.
Alex Chen: Renewal risk: both customers said they'd reconsider renewal in ~60 days if invoices remain unclear. Flagging as at-risk.
Priya Singh: I'll add risk notes to both accounts and escalate to AMs. Can we also surface a UI badge for routes with >5% discrepancy?
Sophia Park: UI flag is a nice-to-have. Let's do export + checklist first. I'll create a ticket and scope daily cadence.
cs-bot: Ticket created RH-4987: "Per-route billing export + onboarding checklist" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RH-4987
Tom Reed: For the ticket I'll add a sample CSV and a short implementation note: daily batch job, S3 CSV, link in billing console.
Lena Morales: I'll draft the checklist wording and AM script for the customers. Quick draft: "Confirm route-to-invoice mapping with finance; request sample invoice if discrepancies".
Alex Chen: Thanks team. Action items: Sophia to scope RH-4987, Tom to add CSV schema, Lena to draft checklist, Priya to flag accounts. I'll follow up with customers next week and share AM script. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: Adding customer files to RH-4987 now.
Sophia Park: Noted. Setting initial priority = P1 for export, P2 for checklist, P3 for UI flag.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Keep updates in the ticket.
